name: Hungarian Down Pillow
description: Premium Hungarian white down clusters deliver exceptional loft and an enveloping softness. Naturally insulating and breathable — the pillow that feels like sleeping on a cloud.

name: Memory Foam Contour Pillow
description: Ergonomic contour shape with temperature-responsive memory foam that conforms precisely to the neck and shoulder curve. Provides targeted cervical support for back sleepers and those with neck tension.

name: Shredded Latex Pillow
description: Shredded natural latex fill with an adjustable loft — add or remove fill to dial in your perfect height. Naturally breathable, anti-microbial, and resilient. Ideal for combination sleepers who move during the night.

name: Tech Fiber Pillow
description: High-performance tech fiber fill that stays lofty wash after wash. Machine washable, fully hypoallergenic, and dries quickly — the practical choice for allergy sufferers and busy households.

name: Slim Down Pillow
description: A slim, low-loft down pillow designed specifically for stomach sleepers and those with a petite frame. Keeps the spine neutral and prevents neck strain — lightweight, whisper-soft, and unobtrusive.
